title: SIMPLIFY Digital Platform – E-licensing/e-procurement Platform for Buildings’ Processes
excerpt: This projetct will answer to the increasing demand for an e-licensing platform for municipalities, which will support construction project lifecycle processes.
content:
This projetct will answer to the increasing demand for an e-licensing platform for municipalities, which will support construction project lifecycle processes.

This platform will use BIM to automate several code checkings and provide a collaborative environment to support stakeholders’ engagement.

Main Activities (ongoing)

  • e-licensing and e-procurement framework development, based on existing processes, codes and standards
  • BIM-based collaboration framework
  • BIM digital platform development and implementation
  • Pilot cases
